verdict.rationale: Codex is documented as a general-purpose coding agent that inspects code, edits files, runs commands, and automates repeatable work, which implies it can write tests, fix lint errors, resolve merge conflicts, and update dependencies, but no evidence explicitly names these specific workflows (tests, lint, merge conflicts, dependency updates) as first-class supported tasks. Community feedback is mixed on reliability/quality, with some users praising output quality and others reporting it 'struggles with almost anything,' though this doesn't concretely contradict the general capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on examples of Codex writing tests, fixing lint errors, resolving merge conflicts, or updating dependencies specifically.
